description: Transportation network layers: Oman is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Middle East and North Africa (ROMENA). Oman transportation network shows layers of airports; classification layers for roads; Railways; and ports. Data source WFP 2011. Coverage: Oman. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Middle East and North Africa (ROMENA). Its tags are aviation, geodata, roads, transportation. It offers 3 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2017-03-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Other. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, road safety and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
